name: Hanoi
literature_vertical_cm_per_yr: Up to -6.8 cm/yr vertical (ALOS InSAR 2007-2011), moderating to -0.5 to -0.8 cm/yr in suburban bowls (2016-2020; Dang et al., 2014)
literature_sources: Dang, V.K. et al. (2014), Recent land subsidence in Hanoi from ALOS PALSAR InSAR
agreement_note: Broadly consistent in magnitude (-2.5 cm LOS, -3.6 cm vertical est., -2.1 cm/100d over 120 days), though low valid-pixel fraction (25.7%) over Red River delta vegetation/urbanization and reference spread [-6.7, -2.2] cm limit precision.
press_summary_gate_note: Kept indicative_only due to 25.7% valid pixels and tropical delta reference sensitivity [-6.7, -2.2] cm.
quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team.
